name: How can I prevent future sewage backups in my shower?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future sewage backups in my shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing future sewage backups involves mindful habits and occasional maintenance. Avoid flushing anything other than toilet paper; dispose of wipes, paper towels, and hygiene products in the trash. Be cautious about pouring grease down drains, as it solidifies and causes blockages. Consider having your main sewer line inspected periodically, especially if your home has older pipes or large trees nearby. Regular snaking or hydro-jetting by a plumber can also help clear minor buildups before they become major problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent backups by not flushing non-flushable items, avoiding grease down drains, and considering periodic sewer line inspections and maintenance.
